metadata.title: Sentinel-IPAbuse-TriageAndBlock
metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel playbook that triages IP entities against AbuseIPDB, opens a Trackspace (Jira) approval ticket with a CSV report, polls until the ticket reaches the configured approval status, then appends the approved IPs to a static-site blocklist blob. The Logic App's system-assigned managed identity requires: Microsoft Sentinel Responder on the workspace, Key Vault Secrets User on the Key Vault, and Storage Blob Data Contributor on the blocklist storage account.
prerequisites: Key Vault secret '<JiraKeyVaultSecretName>' holding the Trackspace service account password.
Storage account hosting the blocklist with test/index.html present (static website enabled).
AzureSentinel and KeyVault API connections (this template creates them if absent).

OMS-owned AbuseIPDB API connection 'abuseipdb-connection-AbuseIPDB-EnrichIncidentByIPInfo' in resource group LSY_WEUR_ITCS_PRD_OMS_RG_001 already authorised; this template does not create or modify it.
metadata.author: TI handling automation

metadata.description: Name for the Logic App and its API connections.
Azure region for the Logic App. Must match the existing Sentinel/Key Vault region.
Name of the Key Vault holding the AbuseIPDB API key and the Jira service account password.
Key Vault secret name storing the Trackspace password.
Status string (compared case-insensitively) that signals the analyst approved the blocklist push.

Numeric Jira workflow transition id used to move the approval ticket from Approval to In Progress, fired immediately after the analyst's approval and before the blocklist is touched. Verified in CLOPSSEC on 2026-05-12 as id 811 (name 'Approve').
Numeric Jira workflow transition id used to move the ticket from In Progress to Resolved after the blocklist has been updated. Verified in CLOPSSEC on 2026-05-12 as id 5 (name 'Resolve issue').

Numeric Jira workflow transition id used to move the ticket from Resolved to Closed. Verified in CLOPSSEC on 2026-05-12 as id 701 (name 'Close'). Discover transition ids for other Jira workflows via GET /rest/api/2/issue/<any-key>/transitions.

Storage account hosting the blocklist. Currently pointed at the SEC test account (lsyweuritcststsec01, RG LSY_WEUR_ITCS_PRD_SEC_RG_002) for end-to-end playbook validation; flip back to lsyweuritcsprdmspalo001 once testing is complete.
Container holding the blocklist blob. 'test' for the SEC test account; flip back to '$web' for the production palo static-site account.
Inclusive lower bound for AbuseIPDB totalReports. IPs with fewer reports are dropped.
ISP names (lower-case) whose IPs are always dropped, even if totalReports >= MinReports.
Until loop iteration cap. With a 5-minute poll, 576 ≈ 48h.
ISO 8601 duration the playbook will wait for the Jira task to reach the approval status.

body.message:
Trackspace (Jira) unreachable
HTTP status: @{outputs('Jira_health_check')?['statusCode']}. The IP-abuse playbook has been aborted; no triage ticket was opened and the blocklist was not modified.

runError.message: GET /rest/api/2/myself against the Trackspace base URL returned a non-success status during the health check.

fields.summary: MANUAL REVIEW REQUIRED — AbuseIPDB unreachable for Sentinel #@{triggerBody()?['object']?['properties']?['incidentNumber']}

body.message:
MANUAL — AbuseIPDB was unreachable
HTTP @{outputs('AbuseIPDB_health_check')?['statusCode']} on health check. A triage ticket has been opened with the raw IP list (no enrichment) attached: @{body('Parse_Create_Manual_Jira_Task_Body')?['key']}. The blocklist will not be modified automatically — analyst must triage by hand or re-run the playbook once AbuseIPDB recovers.

runError.message: AbuseIPDB /check returned a non-success status for 8.8.8.8 during the health check.

body.message:
IP-abuse playbook finished without action.
After AbuseIPDB enrichment, no IPs met the threshold (totalReports ≥ @{parameters('MinReports')} and ISP not in the excluded list). Closing this incident as BenignPositive - SuspiciousButExpected.

classification.ClassificationReasonText: AbuseIPDB enrichment returned no actionable IPs (totalReports < @{parameters('MinReports')} or excluded ISP).

body.message:
IP-abuse playbook — approval ticket opened
Trackspace: @{body('Parse_Create_Jira_Task_Body')?['key']}
@{length(variables('Kept_IPs'))} IPs await analyst approval. The playbook will poll Jira every @{parameters('ApprovalPollIntervalMinutes')} minutes for up to @{parameters('ApprovalTimeout')}.

add.body: Sentinel playbook: analyst approval received. Advancing ticket to In Progress; about to update the blocklist.

body.message:
Approval received on @{body('Parse_Create_Jira_Task_Body')?['key']}.
@{length(body('Filter_Unique_New_IPs'))} new IP(s) appended to @{parameters('StorageAccountName')}/@{parameters('BlocklistContainer')}/@{parameters('BlocklistBlobPath')}; @{sub(length(variables('Kept_IPs')), length(body('Filter_Unique_New_IPs')))} already present and skipped.

add.body: Sentinel playbook: blocklist update complete — @{length(body('Filter_Unique_New_IPs'))} new IP(s) appended. Transitioning ticket to Resolved.

body.message:
Approval received but ticket transition failed.
Could not move @{body('Parse_Create_Jira_Task_Body')?['key']} out of Approval. The blocklist was NOT modified. Fix the ticket-side issue (permissions, workflow state) and re-run the playbook on this incident.

Blocklist updated, but ticket close-out chain failed.
Trackspace ticket @{body('Parse_Create_Jira_Task_Body')?['key']} may be stuck in In Progress or Resolved. Manual transition to Closed required. The IPs WERE appended to the blocklist; this failure is cosmetic.

Approval not received for @{body('Parse_Create_Jira_Task_Body')?['key']}.
Last observed Jira status: @{coalesce(body('Parse_Jira_Status')?['fields']?['status']?['name'], 'unknown / timeout')}. The blocklist was not modified.
